propositions: Jira mutation decisions scattered across differ, apply, handlers, and orchestration lack unified retry ownership and terminal failure scoping, causing compound updates to replay unpredictably and late failures to lack stable per-ticket versus batch disposition.

Retry policy lacks enforcement: no provider-neutral coordinator bounds retry attempts to three physical invocations and 15 seconds cumulative sleep per logical postcondition, nor respects Retry-After as a lower bound by deferring long waits with retry_not_before.

Endpoint-failure protection is missing; only a per-pass blast-radius guard exists (classify.check_blast_radius), not a scoped fuse that triggers after three consecutive exhausted eligible logical outcomes across at least two tickets.
Shadow planning and versioned preview lifecycle intents cannot be produced from a single observation without triggering remote or local effects, blocking safe cutover by operation family.

Create operation containment must enforce label-first (rebar-id:<local_id>) strategy followed by optional property enrichment, with safety-abort on known-key persistence failure to prevent silent duplicates after timeout.

Live end-to-end validation is required against both Jira Cloud (bounded to uniquely-labeled throwaway issues with guaranteed cleanup) and Jira Data Center (ephemeral isolated instance) exercising coordinator, create/binding-lifecycle, commit-unknown recovery, and endpoint/provider fuse.
